tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags sde slob dpon nas zhus 'dod gsol// oṃ swasti/ snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan 'phags bod kyi/ /mkhas grub spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam rten 'di la/ /bzhugs nas 'phral yun re smon dngos grub stsol/ /chos skyong 'dod gsol/ oṃ swasti/ rgyal bstan spyi bye'i mel tsher thub dbang gis/ /bka' bstod dam can rgya mtshor mnga' gsol ba/ /gur mgon lcam dral zhal bzhi las mkhan kun/ /rten 'dir bzhugs la bka' dam ma g.yel zhig/ //ces 'phags sde slob dpon ngag dbang kun bkras kyi thugs 'dod bzhin kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'phags sde slob dpon nas zhus 'dod gsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
